```{r}
library(EloRating)

library(lubridate)

#load life history dataset
life_hist<-read.csv("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/life_history.csv")

source("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Analyses/elo_rating_male_calculator.R")

life_hist$Code<-tolower(life_hist$Code)

# First, ensure all date columns are in proper Date format
date_columns <- c("DOB", "FirstRecorded", "LastSeen1", "DepartureNatalGp", 
                 "DateImmigration1", "LastSeen2", "DateImmigration2",
                 "LastSeen3", "DateImmigration3", "DateImmigration4", "LastSeen4", "DateAdult")

for (col in date_columns) {
  if (col %in% colnames(life_hist)) {
    # Check if column is character type before converting
    if (is.character(life_hist[[col]])) {
      # Try the ISO format first (YYYY-MM-DD)
      life_hist[[col]] <- as.Date(life_hist[[col]], format = "%Y-%m-%d")
      
      # If that results in all NAs, try the alternative format (DD/MM/YYYY)
      if (all(is.na(life_hist[[col]]))) {
        life_hist[[col]] <- as.Date(life_hist[[col]], format = "%d/%m/%Y")
      }
    }
  }
}
#fix spelling
life_hist$Mother[life_hist$Mother == "Nkosikazi"] <- "Nkosikasi"
#remove white spaces

  mutate(across(starts_with("ImmigrationGp"), trimws),
         across(starts_with("BirthGp"),       trimws))
#remove duplicated riga
life_hist <- life_hist %>%
  group_by(Code) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
```

#Fix mispellings of Mother names vs their Individual names
```{r}
library(stringdist)

self_names   <- life_hist %>% distinct(Individual) %>% pull(Individual)
mother_names <- life_hist %>% distinct(Mother) %>% filter(!is.na(Mother)) %>% pull(Mother)

# For every Mother spelling with no exact match in Individual, find the closest one
unmatched <- mother_names[!mother_names %in% self_names]

near_misses <- tibble(Mother_spelling = unmatched) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    closest_Individual = self_names[which.min(stringdist(Mother_spelling, self_names, method = "lv"))],
    distance = min(stringdist(Mother_spelling, self_names, method = "lv"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(distance <= 2) %>%
  arrange(distance)

near_misses

# Build correction lookup: closest_Individual is the "correct" (canonical) spelling
corrections <- near_misses %>%
  mutate(Mother_spelling = trimws(Mother_spelling)) %>%  # handles the "Nooiens " case
  dplyr::select(Mother_spelling, closest_Individual) %>%
  distinct()

corrections

life_hist <- life_hist %>%
  mutate(Mother = trimws(Mother)) %>%  # trim whitespace first (fixes "Nooiens ")
  left_join(corrections, by = c("Mother" = "Mother_spelling")) %>%
  mutate(Mother = if_else(!is.na(closest_Individual), closest_Individual, Mother)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-closest_Individual)

```

#Create presence/absence matrices of individuals in each group
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

build_presence_matrix <- function(life_hist,
                                  group_name,
                                  start_date = "2010-06-24",  # IVP start date
                                  end_date   = Sys.Date()) {
  
  # ── 1. Filter individuals who ever belonged to this group ──────────────────
  group_individuals <- life_hist %>%
    filter(
      BirthGp        == group_name |
      ImmigrationGp1 == group_name |
      ImmigrationGp2 == group_name |
      ImmigrationGp3 == group_name |
      ImmigrationGp4 == group_name
    )
  
  if (nrow(group_individuals) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No individuals found for group:", group_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # ── 2. Determine start date for the group ──────────────────────────────────
  # Priority: earliest DOB of natal individuals > earliest immigration date > FirstRecorded
  birth_dates <- life_hist %>%
    filter(BirthGp == group_name, !is.na(DOB)) %>%
    pull(DOB)
  
  if (length(birth_dates) > 0) {
    start_date <- min(birth_dates)
  } else {
    imm_dates <- life_hist %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols      = matches("^ImmigrationGp\\d+$"),
        names_to  = "imm_col",
        values_to = "imm_group"
      ) %>%
      filter(imm_group == group_name) %>%
      mutate(
        event_num = str_extract(imm_col, "\\d+"),
        date_col  = paste0("DateImmigration", event_num)
      ) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(imm_date = get(date_col)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!is.na(imm_date)) %>%
      pull(imm_date)
    
    if (length(imm_dates) > 0) {
      start_date <- min(imm_dates)
    } else {
      warning(paste("No birth or immigration dates for group:", group_name,
                    "- using earliest FirstRecorded"))
      start_date <- min(life_hist$FirstRecorded, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  end_date <- as.Date(end_date)
  
  # ── 3. Build presence intervals per individual ─────────────────────────────
  # get_intervals is nested here so it can access group_name and end_date
  
  get_intervals <- function(ind) {
    
    intervals <- list()
    
    # ── 3a. Natal interval ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!is.na(ind$BirthGp) && ind$BirthGp == group_name) {
      
      start_pres <- if (!is.na(ind$DOB)) ind$DOB else ind$FirstRecorded
      
      end_pres <- case_when(
        # Male departed natal group
        !is.na(ind$Sex) & ind$Sex == "M" & !is.na(ind$DepartureNatalGp)
          ~ as.Date(ind$DepartureNatalGp),
        # Individual died (has LastSeen1 but no further immigration)
        !is.na(ind$LastSeen1) & is.na(ind$DateImmigration1)
          ~ as.Date(ind$LastSeen1),
        # Still present
        TRUE ~ as.Date(end_date)
      )
      
      intervals <- c(intervals, list(c(start_pres, end_pres)))
    }
    
    # ── 3b. Immigration intervals ─────────────────────────────────────────
    for (k in 1:4) {
      
      grp_col  <- paste0("ImmigrationGp",   k)
      date_col <- paste0("DateImmigration", k)
      ls_col   <- paste0("LastSeen",        k)
      
      # Skip if this immigration was not to our group or has no date
      if (is.na(ind[[grp_col]]) || ind[[grp_col]] != group_name) next
      if (is.na(ind[[date_col]])) next
      
      start_pres <- as.Date(ind[[date_col]])
      
      # Only look for next immigration date if k < 4 (DateImmigration5 does not exist)
      next_date <- if (k < 4) {
        next_col <- paste0("DateImmigration", k + 1)
        if (!is.na(ind[[next_col]])) as.Date(ind[[next_col]]) else NA_Date_
      } else {
        NA_Date_
      }
      
      end_pres <- case_when(
        !is.na(next_date)      ~ next_date,
        !is.na(ind[[ls_col]]) ~ as.Date(ind[[ls_col]]),
        TRUE                   ~ as.Date(end_date)
      )
      
      intervals <- c(intervals, list(c(start_pres, end_pres)))
    }
    
    # Return as tidy dataframe of intervals
    if (length(intervals) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    map_dfr(intervals, ~ tibble(
      Code  = ind$Code,
      start = as.Date(.x[1]),
      end   = as.Date(.x[2])
    ))
  }
  
  # Apply get_intervals to all individuals
  all_intervals <- group_individuals %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map(get_intervals) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  if (nrow(all_intervals) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No valid presence intervals for group:", group_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # ── 4. Build date sequence and expand to presence matrix ───────────────────
  date_seq <- tibble(Date = seq(start_date, end_date, by = "day"))
  
  presence_matrix <- date_seq %>%
    crossing(all_intervals) %>%
    filter(Date >= start, Date <= end) %>%
    distinct(Date, Code) %>%
    mutate(present = 1L) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Code,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0L
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  return(presence_matrix)
}

# ── Wrapper to run for all groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────
build_all_presence_matrices <- function(life_hist,
                                        groups   = c("IF", "KB", "BD", "CR", "LT", "NH", "AK"),
                                        end_date = Sys.Date()) {
  matrices <- list()
  
  for (grp in groups) {
    result <- tryCatch(
      build_presence_matrix(life_hist, grp, end_date),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(paste("Error processing group:", grp, "-", e$message))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (!is.null(result)) matrices[[grp]] <- result
  }
  
  return(matrices)
}

# Usage:
 group_presence_matrices <- build_all_presence_matrices(life_hist)
 View(group_presence_matrices[["AK"]])
```

```{r}
analyze_male_emigration <- function(life_hist, group_presence_matrices) {
  
  # Step 1: Filter males who emigrated
 emigrant_males <- life_hist %>%
  filter(Sex == "M",
         !is.na(ImmigrationGp1),
         !is.na(DateImmigration1) | !is.na(DepartureNatalGp)) %>%
  mutate(
    Tenure = if_else(!is.na(DateImmigration1),
                      if_else(!is.na(LastSeen1),
                              as.numeric(LastSeen1 - DateImmigration1),
                              as.numeric(Sys.Date() - DateImmigration1)),
                      NA_real_),
    juvenile_period_end = case_when(
      !is.na(DepartureNatalGp) ~ as.Date(DepartureNatalGp),
      is.na(DepartureNatalGp) & !is.na(DateImmigration1) ~ as.Date(DateImmigration1),
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    juvenile_period_length_days = as.numeric(juvenile_period_end - DOB)
  )
  
# Step 2: Apply mother presence check row by row using a loop
  results <- emigrant_males
  results$mother_present_at_dispersal <- NA
  results$mother_days_present <- NA
  results$mother_presence_proportion <- NA

  for (i in 1:nrow(results)) {
    # Skip if no mother info or DOB
    mother_name <- results$Mother[i]
    if (is.na(mother_name) || mother_name == "" || mother_name == " " || is.na(results$DOB[i])) {
      results$mother_present_at_dispersal[i] <- NA
      results$mother_days_present[i] <- NA
      results$mother_presence_proportion[i] <- NA
      next
    }

    natal_group <- results$BirthGp[i]
    mother_code <- life_hist$Code[life_hist$Individual == mother_name][1]
    dob <- results$DOB[i]
    period_end <- results$juvenile_period_end[i]

    # Check if we have valid data
    if (is.na(natal_group) || !natal_group %in% names(group_presence_matrices) ||
        is.na(mother_code) || length(mother_code) == 0 || is.na(period_end)) {
      results$mother_present_at_dispersal[i] <- FALSE
      results$mother_days_present[i] <- 0
      results$mother_presence_proportion[i] <- NA
      next
    }

    presence_matrix <- group_presence_matrices[[natal_group]]

    # Check if mother is in the matrix
    if (!mother_code %in% colnames(presence_matrix)) {
      results$mother_present_at_dispersal[i] <- FALSE
      results$mother_days_present[i] <- 0
      results$mother_presence_proportion[i] <- NA
      next
    }

    # Get relevant dates
    relevant_dates <- presence_matrix %>%
      filter(Date >= dob & Date <= period_end)

    if (nrow(relevant_dates) == 0) {
      results$mother_present_at_dispersal[i] <- FALSE
      results$mother_days_present[i] <- 0
      results$mother_presence_proportion[i] <- NA
    } else {
      days_present <- sum(relevant_dates[[mother_code]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      total_days   <- nrow(relevant_dates)

      results$mother_days_present[i] <- days_present
      results$mother_presence_proportion[i] <- days_present / total_days
      results$mother_present_at_dispersal[i] <- all(relevant_dates[[mother_code]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  results <- results %>%
  select(Code, Mother, BirthGp, DOB, ImmigrationGp1, DateImmigration1, DepartureNatalGp,
         LastSeen1, Tenure, juvenile_period_end, juvenile_period_length_days,
         mother_present_at_dispersal, mother_days_present, mother_presence_proportion)

  return(results)
}

emigrants <- analyze_male_emigration(life_hist, group_presence_matrices)
```

This section builds a winner-loser table from agonistic interactions using:
- Tiered aggression winner/loser logic (adapted from Tankink/Mercier)
- Actual daily presence filtering via presence matrices
- Age class assignment at time of conflict

```{r group-name-mapping}
# Map long group names to codes used in presence matrices
group_code_map <- c(
  "Ankhase"     = "AK",
  "Baie Dankie" = "BD",
  "Noha"        = "NH",
  "Kubu"        = "KB",
  "Lemon Tree"  = "LT",
  "IFamily"     = "IF",
  "Crossing"    = "CR"
)

long_to_code <- function(name) {
  ifelse(name %in% names(group_code_map), group_code_map[name], name)
}
```

```{r tiered-winner-loser-logic}
# Tiered winner/loser decision
# Priority: retreat/submission asymmetry > severe aggression > chase > mild aggression
# Returns: 1 if beh1 wins, 2 if beh2 wins, 0 if draw

decide_win_factory <- function() {
  
  # Retreat / submission codes (merged from both scripts)
  retreat <- c("fl", "rt", "av", "ja", "cr", "ss", "gu", "re", "le", "sc")
  
  # Aggression tiers: severe -> chase -> mild
  cat3 <- c("bi", "gb", "hi", "fi", "hh", "so", "fm")          # severe
  cat2 <- c("ch")                                                # chase
  cat1 <- c("ac", "ag", "at", "dp", "tp", "st", "su",
             "fh", "sf", "hb", "bd", "ap")                      # mild
  
  # Count occurrences of any code from a set in a behaviour string
  count_set <- function(s, codes) {
    s <- tolower(paste0(s, collapse = " "))
    sum(vapply(codes, function(cd) str_count(s, fixed(cd)), integer(1)))
  }
  
  function(beh1, beh2) {
    # 1) Retreat/submission asymmetry
    r1 <- count_set(beh1, retreat)
    r2 <- count_set(beh2, retreat)
    if (r1 > r2) return(2L)  # beh1 retreated more -> beh2 wins
    if (r2 > r1) return(1L)  # beh2 retreated more -> beh1 wins
    
    # 2) Tiered aggression comparison (severe first, then chase, then mild)
    for (cats in list(cat3, cat2, cat1)) {
      c1 <- count_set(beh1, cats)
      c2 <- count_set(beh2, cats)
      if (c1 > c2) return(1L)
      if (c2 > c1) return(2L)
    }
    
    # 3) Fully tied -> draw
    return(0L)
  }
}

decide_win <- decide_win_factory()
```


The age estimation works like this:

If DOB is known: age = (target_date - DOB) in years. Straightforward.
If DOB is unknown but FirstRecorded exists: age = (target_date - FirstRecorded) in years. This underestimates true age because FirstRecorded is when researchers first saw them, not when they were born.
If DOB is unknown AND BirthGp is unknown (i.e., the individual was first observed as an immigrant with no birth records): add 5 years to the estimate from step 2. This is because these individuals are almost certainly adult males who immigrated from unmonitored groups. They were likely 4-5+ years old when first recorded, so adding 5 years compensates for the underestimation. Without this, a male first seen 6 months ago would get age = 0.5 and be classified as "BB" — obviously wrong for an immigrant male.

```{r age-helper-functions}
# Calculate age in years at a given date
calculate_age <- function(date_of_birth, first_recorded, target_date, birthgp) {
  base <- ifelse(
    is.na(date_of_birth),
    as.numeric(difftime(target_date, first_recorded, units = "weeks")) / 52.143,
    as.numeric(difftime(target_date, date_of_birth,  units = "weeks")) / 52.143
  )
  base + ifelse(is.na(date_of_birth) & is.na(birthgp), 5, 0)
}
 
get_age_class <- function(Sex, Age, departure_natal, target_date,
                          present_gp, birth_gp, date_adult = NA) {
  case_when(
    is.na(Sex) ~ NA_character_,
    # DateAdult check FIRST — overrides missing age
    !is.na(date_adult) & target_date >= date_adult & Sex == "F" ~ "AF",
    !is.na(date_adult) & target_date >= date_adult & Sex == "M" ~ "AM",
    # Now check for missing age
    is.na(Age) ~ NA_character_,
    # Standard age-based classification
    Age < 1                                                        ~ "BB",
    Sex == "F" & Age >= 3                                          ~ "AF",
    Sex == "F" & Age >= 1 & Age < 3                                ~ "JF",
    Sex == "M" & Age >= 1 & Age < 4                                ~ "JM",
    Sex == "M" & Age >= 4 & (present_gp == birth_gp)               ~ "SM",
    Sex == "M" & Age >= 4 & Age < 5 &
      (is.na(departure_natal) | departure_natal <= target_date)    ~ "AM",
    Sex == "M" & Age >= 5                                           ~ "AM",
    TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r build-winner-loser}
# Build raw winner-loser table from agonistic data
# Uses tiered decision logic defined above

build_winner_loser <- function(agonistic_data) {
  
  agonistic_data %>%
    transmute(
      date      = as.Date(date),
      group     = long_to_code(as.character(group)),
      Aggressor = tolower(as.character(Aggressor)),
      Victim    = tolower(as.character(Victim)),
      BehAgg    = tolower(as.character(AggressorBehaviour)),
      BehVic    = tolower(as.character(VictimBehaviour))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      who_wins = mapply(decide_win, BehAgg, BehVic),
      winner   = case_when(who_wins == 1 ~ Aggressor,
                           who_wins == 2 ~ Victim,
                           TRUE          ~ NA_character_),
      loser    = case_when(who_wins == 1 ~ Victim,
                           who_wins == 2 ~ Aggressor,
                           TRUE          ~ NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(winner), !is.na(loser), winner != loser) %>%
    dplyr::select(date, group, winner, loser, BehAgg, BehVic) %>%
    arrange(date)
}
```

```{r filter-by-presence}
# Filter conflicts to only those where both individuals were actually present
# on the exact date of the conflict (checked against daily presence matrices)

filter_conflicts_by_presence <- function(conflict_data, group_presence_matrices) {
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (grp in unique(conflict_data$group)) {
    
    if (!grp %in% names(group_presence_matrices)) next
    
    group_conflicts <- conflict_data %>% filter(group == grp)
    
    presence <- group_presence_matrices[[grp]] %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
    
    present_individuals <- setdiff(colnames(presence), "Date")
    
    # Keep only conflicts where both individuals exist in the presence matrix
    group_conflicts <- group_conflicts %>%
      filter(winner %in% present_individuals,
             loser  %in% present_individuals)
    
    if (nrow(group_conflicts) == 0) next
    
    # Check actual presence value (== 1) on the conflict date
    valid <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(group_conflicts)), function(i) {
      
      conflict_date <- group_conflicts$date[i]
      w             <- group_conflicts$winner[i]
      l             <- group_conflicts$loser[i]
      
      date_row <- presence[presence$Date == conflict_date, ]
      
      if (nrow(date_row) == 0) return(FALSE)
      
      isTRUE(date_row[[w]] == 1) & isTRUE(date_row[[l]] == 1)
      
    }, logical(1))
    
    results[[grp]] <- group_conflicts[valid, ]
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}
```


```{r add-age-classes}
# Add age and sex class for winner and loser at the time of each conflict
add_age_classes <- function(conflict_data, life_hist) {
 
  # Standardise BirthGp to codes so it matches conflict_data$group
  LH_min <- life_hist %>%
    mutate(BirthGp = long_to_code(BirthGp)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Code, Sex, DOB, FirstRecorded, BirthGp, DepartureNatalGp, DateAdult)
 
  conflict_data %>%
    # Winner demographics
    left_join(LH_min, by = c("winner" = "Code")) %>%
    rename(WinnerSex = Sex, W_DOB = DOB, W_FR = FirstRecorded,
           W_BirthGp = BirthGp, W_DepNat = DepartureNatalGp,
           W_DateAdult = DateAdult) %>%
    mutate(
      WinnerAge      = calculate_age(W_DOB, W_FR, date, W_BirthGp),
      winner_age_cat = get_age_class(WinnerSex, WinnerAge, W_DepNat,
                                     date, group, W_BirthGp, W_DateAdult)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-W_DOB, -W_FR, -W_BirthGp, -W_DepNat, -W_DateAdult) %>%
    # Loser demographics
    left_join(LH_min, by = c("loser" = "Code")) %>%
    rename(LoserSex = Sex, L_DOB = DOB, L_FR = FirstRecorded,
           L_BirthGp = BirthGp, L_DepNat = DepartureNatalGp,
           L_DateAdult = DateAdult) %>%
    mutate(
      LoserAge      = calculate_age(L_DOB, L_FR, date, L_BirthGp),
      loser_age_cat = get_age_class(LoserSex, LoserAge, L_DepNat,
                                    date, group, L_BirthGp, L_DateAdult)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-L_DOB, -L_FR, -L_BirthGp, -L_DepNat, -L_DateAdult)
}
```

```{r run-pipeline}
# Run the full pipeline
# age_classes_to_keep: adjust to "AF", "AM", "JM", "SM" etc. as needed

conflict_data <- newest_aggression_data %>%
  build_winner_loser() %>%
  { message("After winner/loser decision: ", nrow(.), " interactions"); . } %>%
  filter_conflicts_by_presence(group_presence_matrices) %>%
  { message("After presence filter: ", nrow(.), " interactions"); . } %>%
  add_age_classes(life_hist) %>%
  filter(!is.na(winner_age_cat), !is.na(loser_age_cat))  # drop unclassifiable only
```

```{r}
# Breakdown of agonistic rows dropped by build_winner_loser()
# Run inside the Rmd after the "run-pipeline" chunk and after CR has been removed.
# Uses: newest_aggression_data, decide_win, long_to_code, filter_conflicts_by_presence,
#       add_age_classes, group_presence_matrices, life_hist, conflict_data

# 1. Classify every row of the raw data (same cleaning as build_winner_loser)
ag <- newest_aggression_data %>%
  transmute(
    date      = as.Date(date),
    group     = long_to_code(as.character(group)),
    Aggressor = tolower(as.character(Aggressor)),
    Victim    = tolower(as.character(Victim)),
    BehAgg    = tolower(as.character(AggressorBehaviour)),
    BehVic    = tolower(as.character(VictimBehaviour))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    who_wins = mapply(decide_win, BehAgg, BehVic),
    status = case_when(
      is.na(Aggressor) | is.na(Victim) | Aggressor == "" | Victim == "" ~ "missing ID",
      str_detect(Aggressor, ";") | str_detect(Victim, ";")             ~ "coalition",
      Aggressor == Victim                                               ~ "same ID",
      who_wins == 0 & (is.na(BehAgg) | is.na(BehVic))                   ~ "undecided: behaviour missing",
      who_wins == 0                                                     ~ "undecided",
      TRUE                                                              ~ "decided"
    )
  )

# Whole dataset (all age-sex classes)
count(ag, status) %>% mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 3))

# 2. Adult male - adult male conflicts only, both males present in the group that day
#    Aggressor/Victim are copied into winner/loser only so the existing helper
#    functions can classify the dyad; outcome is taken from `status`.
mm <- ag %>%
  filter(status %in% c("decided", "undecided", "undecided: behaviour missing")) %>%
  mutate(winner = Aggressor, loser = Victim) %>%
  filter_conflicts_by_presence(group_presence_matrices) %>%
  add_age_classes(life_hist) %>%
  filter(winner_age_cat == "AM", loser_age_cat == "AM")

count(mm, status) %>% mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 3))

# 3. Per-male wins and losses in decided AM-AM conflicts
#    (for "do some males rarely show submission?")
am <- conflict_data %>% filter(winner_age_cat == "AM", loser_age_cat == "AM")

male_outcomes <- bind_rows(
  am %>% count(id = winner, name = "n") %>% mutate(type = "won"),
  am %>% count(id = loser,  name = "n") %>% mutate(type = "lost")
) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = won + lost, prop_won = won / total) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_won))

male_outcomes
summary(male_outcomes$prop_won)
sum(male_outcomes$lost == 0)  # males never seen losing to another adult male
```

#Check for how many immigrant males we have enough data and calculate mom elos
```{r}
calculate_mother_elo <- function(potential_immig, conflict_data, 
                                  group_presence_matrices, life_hist,
                                  col_suffix = "") {
  
  library(EloRating)
  library(lubridate)
  
  elo_col <- paste0("mother_avg_elo", col_suffix)
  jpl_col <- paste0("juvenile_period_length", col_suffix)
  
  potential_immig <- potential_immig %>%
    mutate(DOB = as.Date(DOB),
           juvenile_period_end = as.Date(juvenile_period_end))  # was: third_birthday
  
  conflict_data <- conflict_data %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  results <- potential_immig %>%
    filter(!is.na(BirthGp)) %>%
    group_by(BirthGp) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(group_data) {
      
      grp <- unique(group_data$BirthGp)
      
      presence <- group_presence_matrices[[grp]]
      if (is.null(presence)) {
        message("No presence data for group: ", grp)
        return(group_data %>% mutate(!!elo_col := NA, !!jpl_col := NA))
      }
      
      presence_individuals <- setdiff(colnames(presence), "Date")
      
      group_conflicts <- conflict_data %>%
        filter(group == grp,
               winner %in% presence_individuals,
               loser  %in% presence_individuals)
      
      if (nrow(group_conflicts) == 0) {
        message("No conflict data for group: ", grp)
        return(group_data %>% mutate(!!elo_col := NA, !!jpl_col := NA))
      }
      
      first_seen <- map_chr(presence_individuals, function(ind) {
        idx <- which(presence[[ind]] > 0)
        if (length(idx) > 0) as.character(presence$Date[min(idx)]) else "9999-12-31"
      }) %>% setNames(presence_individuals)
      
      group_conflicts <- group_conflicts %>%
        filter(date >= as.Date(first_seen[winner]),
               date >= as.Date(first_seen[loser]))
      
      elo_ratings <- tryCatch(
        elo.seq(winner   = group_conflicts$winner,
                loser    = group_conflicts$loser,
                Date     = group_conflicts$date,
                draw     = NULL,
                presence = presence,
                runcheck = FALSE),
        error = function(e) {
          message("Error calculating Elo for group ", grp, ": ", e$message)
          NULL
        }
      )
      
      if (is.null(elo_ratings)) {
        return(group_data %>% mutate(!!elo_col := NA, !!jpl_col := NA))
      }
      
      group_data %>%
        mutate(result = pmap(list(Momcode, DOB, juvenile_period_end), function(mom, dob, period_end) {
          
          if (is.na(mom) || is.na(dob) || is.na(period_end))
            return(list(elo = NA_real_, jpl = NA_real_))
          
          if (!mom %in% colnames(elo_ratings$pmat)) {
            message("Mother ", mom, " not found in Elo ratings for group ", grp)
            return(list(elo = NA_real_, jpl = NA_real_))
          }
          
          end_dt         <- period_end   # was: dob + years(3)
          first_elo_date <- as.Date(min(as.Date(elo_ratings$truedates)))
          extract_start  <- max(dob, first_elo_date)
          
          if (extract_start >= end_dt)
            return(list(elo = NA_real_, jpl = NA_real_))
          
          daterange <- as.numeric(difftime(end_dt, extract_start, units = "days"))
          
          ratings <- tryCatch(
            extract_elo(elo_ratings,
                        extractdate = format(extract_start, "%Y-%m-%d"),
                        daterange   = daterange,
                        IDs         = mom,
                        standardize = TRUE),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          
          if (is.null(ratings) || length(ratings) == 0)
            return(list(elo = NA_real_, jpl = daterange))
          
          list(elo = mean(ratings, na.rm = TRUE), jpl = daterange)
        })) %>%
        mutate(
          !!elo_col := map_dbl(result, "elo"),
          !!jpl_col := map_dbl(result, "jpl")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(-result)
    })
  
  potential_immig %>%
    filter(is.na(BirthGp)) %>%
    mutate(!!elo_col := NA, !!jpl_col := NA) %>%
    bind_rows(results)
}
```

#Check whether males are present in their ImmGp1 1 year after imm
```{r}
#create immigration birthday
emigrants$ImmigBirthday1 <- if_else(
  !is.na(emigrants$DateImmigration1),
  as.Date(emigrants$DateImmigration1) + 365,
  as.Date(emigrants$DepartureNatalGp) + 365
)

check_immigration_presence <- function(potential_immig, group_presence_matrices) {
  potential_immig$IsPresentOnBirthday <- NA
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(potential_immig)) {
    monkey_code <- potential_immig$Code[i]
    immig_group <- potential_immig$ImmigrationGp1[i]
    immig_date <- potential_immig$ImmigBirthday1[i]
    
    presence_matrix <- group_presence_matrices[[immig_group]]
    
    if (is.null(presence_matrix) || is.na(immig_date)) next
    
    date_row_index <- which(presence_matrix$Date == immig_date)
    
    if (length(date_row_index) == 0) {
      warning(paste("Date", immig_date, "not found in presence matrix for group:", immig_group))
      next
    }
    
    if (!(monkey_code %in% colnames(presence_matrix))) {
      warning(paste("Monkey", monkey_code, "not found in presence matrix for group:", immig_group))
      is_present <- FALSE
    } else {
      col_index <- which(colnames(presence_matrix) == monkey_code)
      is_present <- presence_matrix[date_row_index, col_index] == 1
    }
    
    potential_immig$IsPresentOnBirthday[i] <- is_present
  }
  
  return(potential_immig)
}

emigrants <- check_immigration_presence(potential_immig = emigrants, group_presence_matrices)
```

#Check whether males have any conflict in the year after immigration
Both in general and just with males
```{r}
check_male_conflicts_after_immigration <- function(potential_immig, conflict_data) {
  
  potential_immig$HasConflictsAfterImmig <- FALSE
  potential_immig$ConflictCountAfterImmig <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(potential_immig)) {
    male_id <- potential_immig$Code[i]
    immig_group <- potential_immig$ImmigrationGp1[i]
    
    immig_date <- if (!is.na(potential_immig$DateImmigration1[i])) {
      potential_immig$DateImmigration1[i]
    } else {
      as.Date(potential_immig$DepartureNatalGp[i])
    }
    
    if (is.na(immig_date) || is.na(immig_group)) next
    
    end_date <- immig_date + 365
    
    male_conflicts <- conflict_data[
      (conflict_data$winner == male_id | conflict_data$loser == male_id) &
      conflict_data$group == immig_group &
      conflict_data$date >= immig_date &
      conflict_data$date <= end_date &
      !is.na(conflict_data$winner_age_cat) & conflict_data$winner_age_cat == "AM" &
      !is.na(conflict_data$loser_age_cat) & conflict_data$loser_age_cat == "AM",
    ]
    
    conflict_count <- nrow(male_conflicts)
    has_conflicts <- conflict_count > 0
    
    potential_immig$HasConflictsAfterImmig[i] <- has_conflicts
    potential_immig$ConflictCountAfterImmig[i] <- conflict_count
  }
  
  return(potential_immig)
}

emigrants <- check_male_conflicts_after_immigration(potential_immig = emigrants, conflict_data)
```

Warning guide:
No presence data — transient groups not in matrices
No conflict data — males with no conflicts in their time window
Individual X not found in Elo ratings — males who were present but never appeared in a conflict, will get NA
Less than 2 conflicts — can't calculate sequence

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Diagnostic funnel: why do only 70/212 emigrants have mother_avg_elo?
# Run this after your existing pipeline (needs: emigrants, life_hist,
# group_presence_matrices, female_conflict_data all in memory)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

funnel <- tibble(stage = "1. Total emigrants", n = nrow(emigrants))

# Step 2: has a non-NA BirthGp (needed to even enter the per-group loop)
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "2. Has BirthGp",
                   n = sum(!is.na(emigrants$BirthGp)))

# Step 3: BirthGp has a presence matrix at all
has_presence_grp <- !is.na(emigrants$BirthGp) &
  emigrants$BirthGp %in% names(group_presence_matrices)
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "3. BirthGp has presence matrix",
                   n = sum(has_presence_grp))

# Step 4: has Momcode, DOB, and juvenile_period_end all non-NA
# (these three are required before the mom-lookup step even runs)
has_core_fields <- has_presence_grp &
  !is.na(emigrants$Momcode) & !is.na(emigrants$DOB) &
  !is.na(emigrants$juvenile_period_end)
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "4. Has Momcode + DOB + period_end",
                   n = sum(has_core_fields))

# Step 5: mom actually appears in her son's BirthGp presence matrix
# (i.e. was she ever recorded as physically present in that group?)
mom_in_presence <- mapply(function(mom, grp, ok) {
  if (!ok) return(FALSE)
  pm <- group_presence_matrices[[grp]]
  !is.na(mom) && mom %in% colnames(pm)
}, emigrants$Momcode, emigrants$BirthGp, has_core_fields)
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "5. Mom present in son's BirthGp presence matrix",
                   n = sum(mom_in_presence))

# Step 6: mom actually appears in the elo.seq() pmat for that group
# (i.e. she participated in >=1 qualifying AF-AF conflict there)
# — build one elo object per BirthGp, mirroring calculate_mother_elo()
mom_in_elo <- rep(FALSE, nrow(emigrants))
for (grp in unique(emigrants$BirthGp[mom_in_presence])) {
  idx <- which(emigrants$BirthGp == grp & mom_in_presence)
  presence <- group_presence_matrices[[grp]]
  presence_individuals <- setdiff(colnames(presence), "Date")
  group_conflicts <- female_conflict_data %>%
    filter(group == grp, winner %in% presence_individuals, loser %in% presence_individuals)
  if (nrow(group_conflicts) == 0) next
  elo_obj <- tryCatch(
    EloRating::elo.seq(winner = group_conflicts$winner, loser = group_conflicts$loser,
                        Date = group_conflicts$date, draw = NULL,
                        presence = presence, runcheck = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(elo_obj)) next
  mom_in_elo[idx] <- emigrants$Momcode[idx] %in% colnames(elo_obj$pmat)
}
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "6. Mom appears in group's elo.seq pmat",
                   n = sum(mom_in_elo))

# Step 7: final actual count from your pipeline, for comparison
funnel <- add_row(funnel, stage = "7. Actual mother_avg_elo non-NA (pipeline output)",
                   n = sum(!is.na(emigrants$mother_avg_elo)))

print(funnel)
```
